description_zh: 调用ReRunTaskFlowInstance接口，重跑任务流实例
name: ReRunTaskFlowInstance

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

> To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to query the task flow ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the execution record of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424689.html operation to query the execution record ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务流运行记录ID（Id），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424689.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the task flow. You can call the ListTaskFlowVersions operation to query the version number of the task flow
parameters.help_zh: 任务流版本号，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465989.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_version
